svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-attribution-rail-payout-rates; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Illustrative net commission per conversion across referral rails; subtitle: Typical post-scrub USD realization per qualified conversion event; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative midpoints across B2B/fintech/lead-gen rails; verify live partner contracts independently.; caption: High-ticket B2B SaaS, stacked fintech bounties, and 90-second inbound calls dwarf 1%-4% retail affiliate links.; stages: label: Stacked B2B Fintech + SaaS; value: $950 / conv; numeric value: 950.0; detail: Sequential LLC + business banking + corporate card + payroll software bounties on one new entity.; label: B2B SaaS 30% RevShare (12m); value: $640 / conv; numeric value: 640.0; detail: 12-month realized recurring share on a $210/mo B2B software plan net of logo churn.; label: Enterprise Demo + Won CPA; value: $525 / conv; numeric value: 525.0; detail: Blended PartnerStack / Impact payout combining qualified SQL demo fee plus closed-won bonus.; label: Inbound Pay-Per-Call (90s+); value: $135 / call; numeric value: 135.0; detail: Ringba/Phonexa qualified commercial insurance, legal, or home-service call lasting >=90 seconds.; label: Retail E-Commerce Cookie; value: $6 / order; numeric value: 6.0; detail: 3% commission on a $200 consumer cart exposed to 24-hour cookie expiry and coupon poaching.
